GRAN_AUTO_NOTHING_NEW: Every synced Granola meeting has already been carried.
GRAN_AUTO_LATER_RUN: A matched meeting is waiting for a later run (the per-run cap).
None; the next run takes it.
GRAN_CATALOG_FAILED: The meeting catalog could not be saved or read back, so the meeting was not purged.
Repeat the run; the meeting is still on Oracle.
GRAN_CLIENT_TARGET_NOT_OK: The Meetings database could not be read with the Interview OS connection (not shared, or its columns changed), so meetings stay on Oracle.
Jim shares the Meetings database with the LIFE OS Interview OS connection; the next run files them.
MEETINGS_ROW_AMBIGUOUS: Two Meetings rows carry the same source key, so nothing was filed for that meeting.
Delete the duplicate row in Notion; the next run continues.
MEETINGS_READ_INCOMPLETE: The Meetings database could not be read completely.
CLIENT_PAGE_NOT_OURS: A page with that meeting's title already exists and is not this transcript, so nothing was written.
None; Jim's page is never touched. Rename it if the meeting should be carried.
ROUTE_CLIENT_ATTENDEE: A client attendee puts the meeting on the TGP Project page.
ROUTE_INTERNAL_ATTENDEE: Only Bytalos people (and personal mailboxes) are on the call, so it goes on the Bytalos internal page.
ROUTE_CLIENT_TITLE: No attendee decided it and the title names the client, so it goes on the TGP Project page.
ROUTE_INTERNAL_TITLE: No attendee decided it and the title names Bytalos, so it goes on the Bytalos internal page.
ROUTE_NONE: Neither the attendees nor the title tie the meeting to client work.
None; the meeting stays on Oracle.
ROUTE_OTHER_ATTENDEES: Another company is on a Bytalos call, so the meeting is not filed by guess.
None; the meeting stays on Oracle until Jim says where it goes.
ROUTE_TITLE_AMBIGUOUS: The title names both Bytalos and the client and no attendee decides it.
None; the meeting stays on Oracle until Jim says where it goes.
GRAN_PURGE_ALL_UNSUPPORTED: Oracle has not announced the whole-meeting purge, so the meeting was carried but not purged.
Oracle Claude ships the purge_all capability; the next run purges it.
GRAN_PURGE_SCOPE_NOT_CONFIRMED: Oracle's purge reply did not confirm the whole-meeting scope.
Oracle Claude checks the purge; the meeting is carried and catalogued.
PHYSMAIL_FILING_GMAIL_FAILED: Gmail refused or did not answer while filing Physical Mail notices.
PHYSMAIL_FILING_MOVE_FAILED: One Physical Mail notice could not be marked read and moved.
Repeat the run; it is safe to repeat.
PHYSMAIL_FILING_READBACK_MISMATCH: A Physical Mail notice was moved but its labels did not read back as filed.
MANUAL_JOB_IDENTITY_MISSING: The manual job run was given no company or no title.
MANUAL_JOB_LINK_INVALID: The manual job link is not a single-vacancy https link.
Give the employer's own posting link.
MANUAL_JOB_DAY_INVALID: The manual job round day is not a YYYY-MM-DD date.
Give the Central day as YYYY-MM-DD.
MANUAL_JOB_REQUEST_INVALID: The manual job request link is not an https link.
Give the request message's https link or leave it blank.
MANUAL_JOB_ROUND_EVIDENCE_MISSING: The manual job run has neither a round day nor a request message link.
Give the Central day of the call, or the request message link.
MANUAL_JOB_STORE_FAILED: The manual job could not be added to or read from the Jobs store.
Repeat the run; nothing was written to Interview OS.
NETWORK_MATCH_READ_FAILED: The roster could not be read for matching.
NETWORK_NO_ROSTER: An empty roster counts as a failed read, never as zero people.
NETWORK_SURFACE_CONFIG_MISSING: The Network surface configuration is missing.
NETWORK_SURFACE_DEGRADED: The Network surface ran with a part failed.
LAYOUT_COLUMNS_MISSING: A Ledger page's two-column layout did not read back.
None; the page is retried next run.
LAYOUT_TOGGLE_MISMATCH: A Ledger page's Full job description toggle did not read back as written.
None; the old description is untouched and the page is retried.
LAYOUT_OVERVIEW_MISMATCH: A Ledger page's Overview column did not read back as written.
None; the old description is untouched and the page is retried.
LAYOUT_OLD_BLOCKS_CHANGED: A Ledger page changed while it was being moved; nothing was deleted.
None; the page is retried next run.
LAYOUT_READBACK_MISMATCH: A Ledger page did not read back as the two-column layout after the move.
Look at that page; the run reports it.
LAYOUT_SHARD_INVALID: The layout migration was given a shard that is not i/n with n up to 8.
Dispatch again with a shard like 0/4.
NETWORK_SURFACE_SHARD_INVALID: The surface stage was given a shard that is not i/n with n up to 8.
Dispatch again with a shard like 0/8.
LAYOUT_PAGES_FAILED: One or more Ledger pages could not be moved to the two-column layout.
See the counts; failed pages are retried next run.
OUTLOOK_NEWSLETTER_CONFIG_MISSING: The newsletter account list is empty.
OUTLOOK_NOT_SIGNED_IN: The account is not signed in.
RECRUITERS_QUERY_INCOMPLETE: The recruiter query was incomplete, so it is not treated as empty.
ACTION_CHANGED: The page's action changed since the screen was opened, so the click is refused.
CREATE_NOT_VERIFIED: A created page was not confirmed on read-back.
DECISION_CLAIM_FAILED: The decision number could not be claimed.
DECISION_CLAIM_FETCH_FAILED: The claim could not fetch the remote.
DECISION_CLAIM_LOG_UNREADABLE: The claim could not read the git log.
DECISION_CLAIM_REMOTE_UNREADABLE: The claim could not read the remote.
DECISION_CLAIM_TAG_NOT_MADE: The claim tag was not created.
DECISION_CONFLICT: Another decision already exists on this opportunity.
DECISION_HIRED_REOPEN_UNCONFIRMED: Reopening a Hired opportunity needs a second confirmation.
DECISION_NOT_CLOSED: The opportunity is not closed, so it cannot be reopened.
DECISION_SCHEMA_MISSING: The decision properties are missing from the database.
DECISION_STALE_IDENTITY: The page no longer matches the screen that was opened.
GDRIVE_LIFE_OS_FOLDER_AMBIGUOUS: More than one LIFE OS folder is at the top of My Drive.
GDRIVE_LIFE_OS_FOLDER_MISSING: No LIFE OS folder is at the top of My Drive.
HIRING_CALENDAR_INCOMPLETE: The calendar read for Hiring did not finish.
HIRING_LEDGER_TARGET: The Ledger target is not the Job Ledger.
HIRING_PAGES_UNREADABLE: Hiring pages could not be read.
JOB_CLOSED: The job is closed, so outreach is refused.
JOB_PAGE_OUTREACH_NOTION_ERROR: A Notion call failed in job-page outreach.
JOB_STATE_UNKNOWN: The job's state is unknown, so outreach is refused.
M1M2_SANDBOX_DATABASE_UNREADABLE: The sandbox database could not be read.
JOURNEY_SANDBOX_LEDGER_UNREADABLE: The journey proof's sandbox Ledger could not be made or read.
M1M2_SANDBOX_REPORT_SHAPE: The sandbox report is not the expected shape.
NEWSLETTER_TRACE_GMAIL_FAILED: Gmail could not be read for the trace.
NEWSLETTER_TRACE_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: The traced message was not found.
NEWSLETTER_TRACE_MESSAGE_REF_INVALID: The message reference is not a 64-character hash.
Pass the SHA-256 of the message id.
NEWSLETTER_TRACE_READ_ONLY: The trace did not get a read-only connection.
A code defect; it never writes.
NEWSLETTER_TRACE_UNSUPPORTED_SENDER: The sender is not a supported newsletter.
NOT_A_LEDGER_PAGE: The page is not a Job Ledger page.
NOT_A_LIFE_OS_PAGE: The page is not a LIFE OS page.
NOT_LEDGER: The target is not the Job Ledger.
NOT_SANDBOX: The target is not the sandbox, so the proof refuses.
PAGES_UNREADABLE: Pages could not be read for the Close screen.
PAGE_NOT_UNIQUE: More than one sandbox page matches.
PAGE_UNREADABLE: The page could not be read.
PROTECTED_CONTENT_CHANGED: Protected content changed during the write, so it stops.
None; nothing of Jim's is overwritten.
QUERY_INCOMPLETE: A Notion query returned an incomplete result.
REGION_SHAPE_INVALID: The region is not the expected shape.
WEB_BOARDS_FAILING: At least three web boards failed and they are at least half of the boards due in this run.
Read the boards line and the job summary table for the failing boards; the next run retries them.
UNEXPECTED_QUERY: The proof saw an unexpected query.
WORKER_OFF_CONTRACT: The résumé worker's reply was not the expected shape.
WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: The résumé worker could not be reached.
